climate: Warm summers 19–27°C, mild winters 8–17°C; beach weather Oct–Apr.
safety: Very safe overall; usual big-city awareness late at night around nightlife strips.

climate: Famous "four seasons in a day": summers 14–26°C, winters 6–14°C; pack layers.
safety: Very safe and walkable; keep an eye on belongings on late-night trams.

climate: Subtropical: hot humid summers 21–30°C, dry mild winters 10–22°C.
safety: Relaxed and safe; sun protection matters more than street crime.

climate: Sunniest capital: dry hot summers 18–32°C, mild wet winters 8–19°C.
safety: Low crime; standard care in the CBD late at night.

climate: Hot and humid year-round 24–33°C with afternoon downpours; everything is air-conditioned.
safety: Generally safe; watch for bag-snatching on quiet roadsides, use Grab at night.

climate: Tropical 24–32°C all year; sea breeze evenings, monsoon showers Sep–Nov.
safety: Laid-back and safe; usual scooter-traffic caution.

climate: Hot and humid 24–33°C; planned green township with lake breezes.
safety: Quiet, planned and safe; very low street crime.

climate: Tropical 24–32°C year-round with quick storms.
safety: Fine in main areas; keep phones off the roadside kerb and use Grab late.

climate: Humid subtropical: muggy summers 26–34°C, damp cool winters 13–18°C; typhoon season Jul–Sep.
safety: Among the safest cities in Asia; lost wallets famously come back.

climate: Windy city: warm summers, mild winters 12–18°C; less rain than Taipei.
safety: Very safe science-park town.

climate: Mildest big-city climate in Taiwan, 16–30°C, less rain.
safety: Very safe; usual scooter awareness.

climate: Tropical harbour city 20–32°C; warm even in winter.
safety: Safe and friendly; typhoon prep matters more than crime.

climate: Mild and grey: summers 14–23°C, winters 3–9°C; light rain anytime.
safety: Safe for a mega-city; watch phones near road edges and on the Tube late.

climate: Cool and famously drizzly: summers 12–20°C, winters 2–8°C.
safety: Student-friendly; standard UK city-centre awareness at night.

climate: Cool and breezy: summers 11–19°C, winters 1–7°C; bring a windproof coat.
safety: One of the UK's safest cities.

climate: Similar to London but cooler: summers 13–21°C, winters 2–8°C.
safety: Fine in the centre and campus areas; usual night-time care.

climate: Cool Yorkshire weather: summers 12–20°C, winters 1–7°C.
safety: Big student city; stick to lit routes after nights out.

climate: Hot and humid 25–32°C every single day; daily short downpours.
safety: One of the safest cities in the world, day or night.

climate: Oceanic: summers 15–24°C, mild winters 8–15°C; four seasons in a day.
safety: Safe and easy-going; standard CBD late-night awareness.

climate: Windy capital: summers 13–20°C, winters 6–12°C.
safety: Compact and safe; the wind is the biggest hazard.

climate: Dry and sunny: summers 12–23°C, crisp winters 2–12°C.
safety: Safe, flat, cycle-friendly.

climate: Coolest of the four: summers 10–19°C, winters 2–10°C; flats can be cold — check heating.
safety: Small, safe student city.

climate: Real winters: −10 to −4°C Dec–Feb with snow; pleasant summers 14–24°C.
safety: Central areas are orderly and well-policed; carry your documents.

climate: White nights in June; winters −8 to −2°C, summers 13–23°C.
safety: Tourist centre is safe; standard care in transit hubs late.

climate: Continental: snowy winters −12 to −5°C, warm summers 15–25°C.
safety: Calm, student-heavy city.

climate: Siberian: winters −20 to −12°C (dress seriously), summers 15–26°C.
safety: Safe university districts; winter cold is the main risk.
